events.title: Rocket Lab secures additional Synspective Electron bookings
events.canonical_summary: Rocket Lab and Synspective reported 16 additional dedicated Electron missions booked through 2030, following a June contract described as covering 17 launches.
events.known_event_summary: From June through September 2026, Rocket Lab reported additional Synspective Electron bookings through 2030.

facts.proposition: Rocket Lab had 16 additional dedicated Electron missions booked for Synspective through 2030.
Synspective signed a contract for 17 additional Electron launches with Rocket Lab in June 2026.
